main_text.p: municatione cum consistorio coër-ceatur, & vel arresto publico de-tineatur, vel ab officio suspenda-tur: cujus rei ego varia exempla recentiora novi. Et tunc nos non Tyrannidis accusabamus Magistra-tum, nec populum concitaba-mus contra ipsum; sed confugie-bamus ad arma nostra, hoc est, preces, quas ad Magistratum diri-gebamus, quibus emollliebamus iram ejus. Idem Magistratus pro suo arbitrio, aut auger[?], aut dimi-nuit numerum ministrorum & sa-laria eorum. Exigit etiam ab u-noquoque ministro juramentum fi-delitatis, quo ille promittit, & ju-rat se in officio suo religiosè ac benè versaturum & Magistratui fi-delem fore: prout etiam illud ego in eâdem causâ praestiti. Nec quis-quam nostrûm illud juramentum un-quam recusavit, & singuli eò me-lius sibi cavebant, ut ne praeter commune delictum etiam perjurii

page.notes: No marginal notes. The running head shows the Q.XIV. division mark with the title Constantini Magni. "auger" is read as "auger" with a doubtful final letter, marked [?]. "emollliebamus" is printed with three l's and is kept as printed. The catchword "notam" sits at the lower right, below the last line. The page contains no paragraph indent, so the text runs as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. The "Digitized by Google" line is excluded.
